text:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 - elevated 5xx rate from service `runtime/model-runner` in prod-east (12.1% 5m). Sudden spike in container restarts and OOM/SIGSEGV in inference worker. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/model-runner/errors (5m window). Logs: https://logs.redwood/prod/model-runner?q=segfault. Please acknowledge.

sara: ack — I'm oncall for eng-runtime. Starting triage now. Can someone confirm scope (regions, customers)? @matt @anita please take if oncall ops. :eyes:

matt: I'm looking at the last 10m of logs. Pods in `prod-east` are OOMing and some show SIGSEGV. Sample from pod model-runner-7f8d: ```
[2026-08-19T02:03:12Z] runtime: allocation failed: std::bad_alloc
[2026-08-19T02:03:12Z] INFO kernel: launching fused_attention_v2
[2026-08-19T02:03:13Z] ERROR: segfault at 0x0 (cpu 3)
[2026-08-19T02:03:13Z] --- SIGSEGV ---
Aborted (core dumped)
```
Container restarted 43 times in 8 minutes. Node-level memory pressure low, GPU memory shows spikes to 98% then sudden failure.

anita: any recent deploys? this looks like a new kernel or fused op regression.

deploy-bot: Deployment: `model-runner` v2.33 promoted to prod-east 14 minutes ago by @ci-bot. Rollout confirmed. See: https://deploys.redwood/model-runner/v2.33

josh: if v2.33 touched kernel/kernel selection or a fused CUDA op, we should rollback asap. Temporary mitigation: route traffic away from prod-east model-runner to fallback pool (model-runner-legacy) and lower batch size to avoid OOM. I can flip routing and set env var.

leo: I'm grabbing a core from one of the restarted pods now and will run `gdb` to get a backtrace. Quick check: `kubectl logs -n prod model-runner-7f8d --previous` shows same stack.

infra-bot: INC created: INC-20260819-57 severity=P1. PagerDuty incident created and stakeholders paged. Ticket: https://incidents.redwood/INC-20260819-57

sara: handing to @matt for investigation/mitigation. My priority is customer comms and keeping other regions healthy. Handoff @ 02:10 UTC.

matt: taking over. Actions I'll run in order: 1) scale down `model-runner` in prod-east to 0 (evict bad pods) 2) patch routing to `model-runner-legacy` 3) rollback to v2.32 if safe 4) set `INFERENCE_MAX_BATCH=1` to reduce per-request memory. Will report progress.

matt: (executing) ```bash
kubectl -n prod scale deploy model-runner --replicas=0 --context=prod-east
kubectl -n prod apply -f routing/route-away-prod-east.yaml
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/model-runner INFERENCE_MAX_BATCH=1
# rollback if needed
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/model-runner model-runner=redwood/model-runner:v2.32
```

josh: pushing a quick routing change now — flip to fallback pool and keep a small throughput cap so we don't overload legacy nodes. :rocket:

matt: rollback applied, routing flipped, batch size env set. Watching metrics...

(10m later)
matt: update: 5xx rate in prod-east dropped from 12.1% -> 0.9% over 5m. Pod restarts stopped after scaling down the v2.33 pods. p95 latency returned to baseline.

leo: gdb backtrace from core (sanitized): ```
#0  0x7f98abcd in fused_attention_v2::compute(...)
#1  0x7f98ef01 in run_inference
#2  0x400f2a in main
#3  0x7f98aaaa in __libc_start_main
# SIGSEGV at fused_attention_v2 kernel when handling long sequence lengths + quantized weights
```
Looks like a kernel-level fault in the fused attention path under specific sequence/quantization shapes.

anita: noted. Initial customer impact: ~18 customers had elevated errors (5xx) during the spike window, highest impact for ACME Corp (paying dedicated), FinCo (low-volume but high-priority), and EduLabs. I contacted ACME support with interim status. Need a follow-up RCA and rollback decision review.

matt: mitigation complete. I'll keep v2.32 running in prod-east until we have a patch. I'll also add a runtime guard to disable fused kernels for quantized models as a short-term safety toggle.

sara: great. Can infra/eng-runtime prepare a reproducer and a hotfix? Timeline expectation: patch in 24-48h, postmortem within 72h.

anita: assigning owners: eng-runtime (matt, leo) to debug & patch fused kernel; eng-ml (anita) to reproduce with quantized model set; support to verify customer-facing fixes. I'll open postmortem doc and link action items. Postmortem: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/INC-20260819-57

infra-bot: Action items created in INC-20260819-57: [A1] rollback validation + keep v2.32, owner: matt; [A2] reproducer & heap/cuda dump, owner: leo; [A3] gated deploy checks for fused ops, owner: anita.

matt: leaving a follow-up note — we should add a canary that exercises long sequence attention with quantized weights to catch this earlier. I'll draft a rollout guard.

sara: marking incident as mitigated at 02:43 UTC. We'll keep the incident open until postmortem complete. Thanks all for fast response. :tada:

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260819-57 status: MITIGATED (P1 -> MITIGATED). Postmortem owner: anita.

anita: postmortem doc created and initial timeline added. Will ping for reviews.

sara: closing oncall handoff notes: rota for next 12h — @matt is primary owner for follow-ups, @sara monitoring customer comms. If anything regresses, re-open Pager.

matt: I'll follow up with a detailed debug log and a patch proposal by EOD.

leo: attaching heap/cuda dumps to the incident ticket now.

sara: thanks everyone. Good job moving fast and protecting customers. We'll reconvene in postmortem. :white_check_mark:
